fields.description: Enter one JSON object. Worked example: {"mode": "fixed", "fields": ["doc_id: str", "page_count: int", "note: str?"]}. Every entry in "fields" is the string "name: type", where type is one of str, int, float, bool, any, and a trailing "?" marks the field optional ("note: str?" is an optional string). Field names must be valid Python identifiers — write "doc_id", not "doc-id" or "doc.id". Modes: "fixed" accepts exactly these fields, "flexible" accepts these plus any extras the data carries, and "observed" infers every field from the data — with "observed" leave "fields" out entirely ({"mode": "observed"}).
fields.label: Schema
fields.name: schema

fields.description: Fields this transform requires in input, by the names rows carry. Used for DAG validation to catch missing fields. For templates, declare every static row field read; [] intentionally exposes the whole row but cannot prove field-scoped shield coverage.
fields.label: Required Input Fields
fields.name: required_input_fields

fields.description: select writes the one entry whose name equals the row's key_field value to output_field. all writes every entry onto every row, each to its own output_field. There is no default.
fields.label: Mode
fields.name: mode

fields.description: Entry name to file. In mode 'select' the names are the key values and are compared exactly as written, so they must be quoted strings; in mode 'all' they are labels. At least one entry.
fields.label: Files
fields.name: files

fields.description: mode 'select' only, and required there: the row field whose value names the entry.
fields.label: Key Field
fields.name: key_field

fields.description: mode 'select' only, and required there: the row field the selected entry's value is written to.
fields.label: Output Field
fields.name: output_field

fields.description: mode 'select' only. What to do when the row's key value names no entry: fail the row (the default), write null, or write default_content.
fields.label: On Miss
fields.name: on_miss

fields.description: The non-null value written when on_miss is 'default'. Required then, refused otherwise.
fields.label: Default Content
fields.name: default_content
